name: Brightwave Retail - Composable CDP
opportunity_context: Inbound off lifecycle pain — audiences rebuilt by hand in Braze and Meta. The ecommerce sponsor wants a retention/LTV-lift POC before committing; Series C means budget exists, but procurement wants ROI proof.
pain_points: Audiences rebuilt manually in each tool; stale syncs; the lifecycle team is blocked on the data team for every change.
next_steps: Sync the top 3 retention audiences from BigQuery to Braze and Meta in a 2-week pilot and measure retention/LTV lift.

name: Meridian Health - Governed Activation
opportunity_context: Sponsored by the CIO's modernization mandate; technical validation underway with the data-platform team. Long in stage (75 days) due to the HIPAA security review and competing IT priorities.
pain_points: PHI can't leave the warehouse; manual list pulls to Salesforce; no governed, auditable activation.
competitor: Legacy CDP; building in-house on dbt.
next_steps: Complete the security/HIPAA review, pilot a governed Salesforce sync on one cohort, then a CIO business-case review.

name: Cobalt Software - Reverse ETL
opportunity_context: Early exploration triggered by the growth team needing product-usage signals in marketing tools; the founder and new Head of Growth are driving it. Fast and trial-oriented.
pain_points: Product events trapped in BigQuery; marketing can't trigger on activation milestones; PLG nurture is generic.
next_steps: Sync 'aha-moment' product events from BigQuery to HubSpot and launch a PLG nurture in a self-serve trial.

name: Vuori - Audience Activation
opportunity_context: Growth-led eval to activate Snowflake audiences into Klaviyo and Meta for personalized retention and paid social.
pain_points: Manual audience builds; stale Meta audiences; the lifecycle team is blocked on the data team.
next_steps: Sync top retention and lookalike audiences from Snowflake to Klaviyo and Meta in a 2-week pilot; measure CAC and retention.

name: Ramp - Warehouse-to-Ads
opportunity_context: Growth marketing wants product and billing data activated into ads and outbound with closed-loop; strong data org, fast eval.
pain_points: Manual CSV exports to ad platforms; stale audiences; no conversion closed-loop back to the warehouse.
competitor: Building in-house on dbt; evaluating Census.
next_steps: Stand up a Snowflake-to-ads sync on one high-intent audience and measure CAC lift with closed-loop reporting.

name: Calendly - PLG Activation
opportunity_context: Demand gen wants product-usage milestones synced to Marketo for PLG nurture; exec sponsor engaged.
pain_points: Product signals trapped in BigQuery; marketing can't trigger on activation milestones.
next_steps: Sync activation events from BigQuery to Marketo and launch a PLG nurture pilot.
